newsitem.title: NORWAY: Hydro to restart idled aluminium output.
newsitem.headline: Hydro to restart idled aluminium output.

text.p: Norwegian industrial group Norsk Hydro ASA said on Friday it would gradually restart idled production capacity of primary aluminium because of increased demand.

"Due to increased demand from our customers and increased metal requirements from Hydro's fabrication activities in Norway, Hydro Aluminium is gradually to restart its idled production capacity of primary aluminium," a statement said.

"Since 1994 production capacity of approximately 70,000 tonnes per year has been shut down at Hydro's metal plants in Norway. During the first quarter of 1997 approximately 20,000 tonnes of this idled capacity will be restarted.
"The restart of remaining capacity will be kept continuously under assessment," Hydro said.
